messages:
Nora: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can leadership give a 1-line mission pitch and a short rebuttal when customers ask why not use cloud provider endpoints?
Diego: Mission line suggestion: 'Make predictable, cost-effective LLM inference simple across hosted, reserved, and private deployments.'
Leah: For the cloud provider question: 'Cloud endpoints are general compute; we optimize the whole inference stack (kernels, routing, KV caching, batching) so teams get lower unit cost and stable latency without building ops.'
Omar: Sales request: can we get a tiny field cheat-sheet (3 bullets) and a 1-paragraph tech blurb for RFIs? Also a line on how to explain Dedicated capacity ROI vs Hosted.
Diego: Suggestion for ROI line: 'Dedicated reduces per-token cost at scale through reserved GPUs, runtime optimizations, and predictable batching. Hosted is best for quick iteration.'
Leah: Action items: product to draft 3-bullet cheat-sheet (Diego), eng-runtime to provide 3 concise tech bullets (Omar), marketing to assemble 1-paragraph RFI blurb (Leah). product-bot: Reminder set for 2026-06-02 to check progress. :spiral_calendar:'
